basis.matching_rule: For each of subject, domain, operation, scope, target_class: if the node field is non-null, basis field must equal it. If basis.target is non-null it must equal node.target. A complete current/valid supporting artifact or other nonconferring basis never grants authority.

blocking_uncertainty.authorized_resolution: A resolver receipt contributes its resolves_ids only if that receipt recursively validates and its authority_kind is resolution.
blocking_uncertainty.bare_resolution_fields: request.resolved_residue_ids and request.resolved_conflict_ids, if present, have no authority effect and must be ignored.
blocking_uncertainty.blocking_conflict: For blocking kinds, any case.conflicts item with relevant absent/true, status in {unresolved,contested}, and id not discharged blocks the request.
blocking_uncertainty.blocking_residue: For blocking kinds, any case.residues item with relevant absent/true, status in {unresolved,contested}, and id not discharged blocks the request.
blocking_uncertainty.irrelevant_uncertainty: Items with relevant=false remain preserved but do not block.
blocking_uncertainty.request_resolver_receipt_ids: Only receipt ids listed in request.resolver_receipt_ids are considered for discharge.

canonical_failure_reasons.action_requires_decision: action deps empty or include non-decision
canonical_failure_reasons.authority_conferring_basis_invalid: basis is missing, nonconferring, stale/invalid, incomplete, or does not match node bounds
canonical_failure_reasons.authority_lineage_missing_dependency: a dependency id is absent from case.receipts
canonical_failure_reasons.comparison_requires_measurements: comparison has <2 deps or a non-measurement dependency
canonical_failure_reasons.composition_requires_semantics: composition deps empty or outside semantic/composition
canonical_failure_reasons.decision_requires_semantics: decision deps empty or outside semantic/composition
canonical_failure_reasons.embedding_not_covered_by_basis: embedded proposal's embedding is outside basis.allowed_embeddings
canonical_failure_reasons.embedding_scope_laundering: embedded proposal is promoted to narrator_fact or preserves_embedding is not true
canonical_failure_reasons.measurement_requires_observation: measurement dependency set is empty or contains non-observation
canonical_failure_reasons.producer_authority_ceiling: producer_type is not permitted to emit authority_kind
canonical_failure_reasons.resolution_dependency_invalid: resolution deps empty or outside measurement/semantic/comparison
canonical_failure_reasons.resolver_basis_mismatch: resolution basis domain/operation is not resolution/resolve
canonical_failure_reasons.semantic_requires_measurement: semantic dependency set is empty or contains non-measurement
canonical_failure_reasons.verification_requires_observation: verification deps empty or include non-observation

receipt_common_fields.status_field: may be present but is never trusted as proof of authority

case_shape.request: same semantic shape as a receipt except its id may be absent; evaluator must treat it as a node to validate and must not insert it into the receipt graph

evaluation_order: Copy request and give it an internal id only if needed for implementation bookkeeping; do not insert it into case.receipts.
Recursively validate only resolver receipts explicitly named by request.resolver_receipt_ids and collect exact resolved ids.
For semantic/composition/decision/action/verification requests, fail first on remaining blocking residue, then on remaining blocking conflict.
Validate the request node recursively under lineage and kind rules.
Return preserved evidence snapshot with allowed/status/reason/authority_kind.

output.preservation: raw_source, proposals, conflicts, residues, and comparison_receipts must be returned as deep structural copies equal to the corresponding input values
output.reason: canonical reason token from this contract

action.authority_domain: basis.authority_domain must be action or execution
action.boundary: decision authority never substitutes for action/execution authority
action.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be recursively valid and have authority_kind=decision

comparison.authority_boundary: may establish a relation among measurements only; it cannot promote semantic truth or select a winner
comparison.dependencies: at least two; every dependency must be authority_kind=measurement and recursively valid

composition.composition_rule: basis.composition_rule must be present and truthy
composition.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be recursively valid and have authority_kind in {semantic,composition}

decision.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be recursively valid and have authority_kind in {semantic,composition}

measurement.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be authority_kind=observation and recursively valid

resolution.basis: required and matching; additionally basis.domain=resolution and basis.operation=resolve
resolution.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be recursively valid and have authority_kind in {measurement,semantic,comparison}
resolution.effect: Only exact ids present in resolves_ids may be discharged
resolution.resolves_ids: must contain at least one id

semantic.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be authority_kind=measurement and recursively valid
semantic.dimension: proposal.dimension must be contained in basis.semantic_dimensions
semantic.embedding: If proposal.embedding is one of the listed embedding operators: claim_level must not equal narrator_fact; preserves_embedding must be true; and proposal.embedding must be contained in basis.allowed_embeddings.

verification.dependencies: one or more; every dependency must be recursively valid and have authority_kind=observation

lineage.cycle_rule: Any dependency cycle invalidates the lineage.
lineage.dependency_resolution: Every id in dependencies must resolve to exactly one receipt in case.receipts. A missing id invalidates the node.
lineage.recursive_rule: Every non-root authority-conferring dependency is recursively revalidated from producer ceiling, source identity, dependencies, basis, and kind-specific rules.
lineage.root_rule: Only authority_kind=observation produced by source_observer with zero dependencies may be a lineage root without a basis.
lineage.source_identity_rule: Every node and request must have source_hash exactly equal to case.source_hash.
lineage.status_rule: status=established is never sufficient and does not shorten recursive validation.

nonclaims: This contract does not establish source legitimacy, cryptographic provenance, semantic correctness of proposals, production Contract E 1.0.0, production execution permission, or universal authority ontology.
Information preservation is not semantic or action authorization.
Agreement count, confidence, status strings, and supporting artifacts do not raise authority ceilings.
purpose: Define the complete pre-freeze normative authority-chain behavior for an independent consumer reproduction. No reference implementation, held-out case, expected outcome, weak control, prior failure record, or result is included.

reason_precedence.blocking: For blocking request kinds, relevant_residue_unresolved precedes relevant_conflict_unresolved and both precede request-node validation.
reason_precedence.node: Within node validation, apply rules in this order: producer ceiling; source identity; observation-root rule if observation; recursive dependency completeness/validity; comparison-specific rule if comparison; basis matching; then kind-specific rules in the order listed in kind_rules.
